text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian's terrific performance awes the crowd and ignites the fighting spirit of Hishi Amazon, who'd been watching from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian wants even more strength. To this end, I recommend the Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Certain the path to growing stronger lies in facing strong opponents, we fix our sights on the Satsuki Sho.
